args.reason: The PRDR serves a declared PRD goal without exceeding it. Every DoD item is current-decision inspection without merging: exit 0 and merge-ok when the floor holds, exit 1 with the blocked conditions when it fails, and a test double proving no gh pr merge call. That is exactly the first goal ('inspect the current merge-eligibility decision without risking a merge'). No DoD item adds storage, history or query capability, which the PRD puts out of scope. The second goal holds because the flag reuses the existing floor reads and gates only the final merge call, so merge eligibility keeps one source of truth. Implementation note, not a reason to overturn: the dry-run path must call the same floor-evaluation function as the real path, not a copy, or the second goal is broken in practice.
